#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline checks for the Eywa campaign toolkit.

Every fixture is built here and executed through the real CLI, so the test
needs no fixture files and no network.  Run it with an ordinary interpreter:

    python3 tests/selftest.py
"""
import base64
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
CLI = ROOT / "campaign_cli.py"


def ktest(objects, arguments=0):
    """Encode a KTEST v3 payload from `[(name, bytes), ...]` pairs."""
    payload = b"KTEST" + (3).to_bytes(4, "big") + arguments.to_bytes(4, "big")
    for _ in range(arguments):
        payload += (0).to_bytes(4, "big")
    payload += (0).to_bytes(4, "big") + (0).to_bytes(4, "big")
    payload += len(objects).to_bytes(4, "big")
    for name, data in objects:
        raw = name.encode()
        payload += len(raw).to_bytes(4, "big") + raw
        payload += len(data).to_bytes(4, "big") + data
    return base64.b64encode(payload).decode()


def cell(name, value, width):
    return (name, int(value).to_bytes(width, "little"))


def run(document):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(CLI)],
                          input=json.dumps(document).encode(),
                          capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())


def run_raw(payload):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(CLI)],
                          input=payload, capture_output=True)
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout.decode()


CHECKS = []


def check(function):
    CHECKS.append(function)
    return function


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures


def nested_campaign():
    types = [
        {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
        {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
        {"name": "C", "kind": "char"},
        {"name": "S3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
        {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b"]},
        {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "U8", "size": 2},
        {"name": "P", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f", "U8"], ["g", "B"]]},
        {"name": "AliasP", "kind": "alias", "target": "P"},
        {"name": "V", "kind": "void"},
    ]
    modules = [
        {"name": "helper", "params": [["x", "U8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
         "requires": None},
        {"name": "top", "params": [["a", "AliasP"], ["s", "S3"], ["e", "E"],
                                   ["arr", "Arr"], ["c", "C"]],
         "result": ["out", "V"], "requires": None},
    ]
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [["top", "helper"]],
            "pipes": [], "entries": ["top"], "machine": None, "runs": []}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ checks


@check
def plan_layout():
    plan = run(nested_campaign())["plans"][0]
    assert plan["modules"] == ["helper", "top"], plan["modules"]
    assert plan["types"] == ["P", "AliasP", "E"], plan["types"]
    assert plan["slots"] == [
        ["x1", ["a", "f"], 1], ["x2", ["a", "g"], 1],
        ["x4", ["s", 0], 1], ["x5", ["s", 1], 1], ["x6", ["s", 2], 1],
        ["x7", ["e"], 4],
        ["x9", ["arr", 0], 1], ["x10", ["arr", 1], 1],
        ["x11", ["c"], 1]], plan["slots"]
    assert plan["variables"] == 12 and plan["flag"] is None


@check
def value_recovery():
    document = nested_campaign()
    objects = [cell("x1", 5, 1), cell("x2", 1, 1),
               cell("x4", ord("a"), 1), cell("x5", 0, 1), cell("x6", ord("z"), 1),
               cell("x7", 1, 4), cell("x9", 1, 1), cell("x10", 2, 1),
               cell("x11", 200, 1)]
    document["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects)}]
    answer = run(document)
    assert answer["records"] == [{"status": "READY", "case": 0,
                                 "model_result": None}]
    assert answer["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {
        "a": {"f": 5, "g": True}, "s": "a", "e": "b", "arr": [1, 2], "c": "È"}


@check
def strict_inventory():
    document = nested_campaign()
    good = [cell("x1", 5, 1), cell("x2", 1, 1), cell("x4", 97, 1),
            cell("x5", 0, 1), cell("x6", 122, 1), cell("x7", 1, 4),
            cell("x9", 1, 1), cell("x10", 2, 1), cell("x11", 200, 1)]
    cases = {
        "missing": [o for o in good if o[0] != "x7"],
        "unknown": good + [cell("x12", 0, 1)],
        "duplicate": good + [cell("x7", 1, 4)],
        "composite id": good + [cell("x0", 0, 1)],
        "string buffer id": good + [cell("x3", 0, 1)],
        "width": [cell("x1", 5, 2)] + good[1:],
        "bool range": [cell("x2", 2, 1)] + good[:1] + good[2:],
    }
    for label, objects in cases.items():
        document["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest(objects)}]
        assert run(document)["records"] == [{"status": "INVALID_TEST"}], label
    # Padding bits: U8 is 8 bits, so only 0..255 is admissible.
    # A 12 bit int makes the check observable instead.
    document["types"] = [{"name": "I12", "kind": "int", "bits": 12}]
    document["modules"] = [{"name": "top", "params": [["a", "I12"]],
                            "result": ["out", "I12"], "requires": None}]
    document["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": ktest([cell("x0", 1 << 12, 2)])}]
    assert run(document)["records"] == [{"status": "INVALID_TEST"}]
    # Trailing bytes and broken base64.
    for payload in [ktest(good) + "AAAA", "!!!", ""]:
        document["runs"] = [{"entry": "top", "ktest": payload}]
        assert run(document)["records"] == [{"status": "INVALID_TEST"}]


@check
def pipes_and_flag():
    types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
             {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2}]
    modules = [
        {"name": "entry", "params": [["n", "U8"], ["s", "Str"]],
         "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
        {"name": "f1", "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
         "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 10]]},
        {"name": "f2", "params": [["t", "Str"], ["v", "U8"]], "result": ["o2", "U8"],
         "requires": ["match", ["var", "t"], "[ab]*"]},
        {"name": "f3", "params": [["u", "U8"]], "result": ["o3", "U8"],
         "requires": ["ne", ["var", "u"], ["const", "U8", 0]]},
    ]
    pipes = [
        {"target": "entry", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"q": "n"}},
        {"target": "entry", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"t": "s", "v": "n"}},
        {"target": "f2", "filter": "f3", "bind": {"u": "v"}},
    ]
    document = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
                "entries": ["entry"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    plan = run(document)["plans"][0]
    assert plan["modules"] == ["f1", "f3", "f2", "entry"], plan["modules"]
    assert plan["flag"] == "x7" and plan["variables"] == 8

    def payload(n, string, result, flag):
        objects = [cell("x0", n, 1),
                   cell("x2", ord(string[0]), 1), cell("x3", ord(string[1]), 1),
                   cell("x6", result, 1), cell("x7", flag, 1)]
        return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    for run_input, expected in [
            ((5, "ab", 0, 0), "READY"),
            ((5, "ab", 0, 1), "INVALID_TEST"),      # flag mismatch
            ((15, "ab", 0, 1), "FILTERED"),          # f1 rejects
            ((15, "ab", 0, 0), "INVALID_TEST"),      # flag mismatch
            ((5, "ax", 0, 1), "FILTERED"),           # f2 rejects
            ((0, "ab", 0, 1), "FILTERED")]:          # f3 rejects transitively
        document["runs"] = [payload(*run_input)]
        assert run(document)["records"][0]["status"] == expected, run_input


@check
def state_preparation():
    types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
             {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
             {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["s0", "s1", "s2"]}]
    modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"]],
                "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]

    def machine(transitions):
        return {"states": ["s0", "s1", "s2"], "initial": "s0",
                "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
                "transitions": transitions}

    def payload(index, message):
        objects = [cell("x0", index, 4),
                   cell("x2", ord(message[0]), 1), cell("x3", 0, 1),
                   cell("x4", 0, 1)]
        return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    document = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["entry"], "runs": [], "machine": machine([
                    {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
                    {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None},
                    {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "c", "cost": 2, "when": None},
                    {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "x", "cost": 1, "when": None}])}
    document["runs"] = [payload(2, "hi")]
    corpus = run(document)["corpus"][0]
    assert corpus["commands"] == ["a", "x", "hi"] and corpus["cost"] == 2
    document["runs"] = [payload(0, "go")]
    corpus = run(document)["corpus"][0]
    assert corpus["commands"] == ["go"] and corpus["cost"] == 0
    document["runs"] = [payload(2, "hi")]
    # A guard that only fires for the desired state s2.
    document["machine"]["transitions"][0]["when"] = [
        "eq", ["var", "state"], ["const", "State", "s2"]]
    assert run(document)["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "x", "hi"]
    document["runs"] = [payload(1, "hi")]
    assert run(document)["records"] == [{"status": "UNREACHABLE"}]
    # Cost beats command count; command count beats lexicographic order.
    document["machine"] = machine([
        {"from": "s0", "to": "s2", "command": "z", "cost": 3, "when": None},
        {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
        {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None}])
    document["runs"] = [payload(2, "m")]
    assert run(document)["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["a", "b", "m"]
    document["machine"] = machine([
        {"from": "s0", "to": "s2", "command": "z", "cost": 2, "when": None},
        {"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "a", "cost": 1, "when": None},
        {"from": "s1", "to": "s2", "command": "b", "cost": 1, "when": None}])
    document["runs"] = [payload(2, "m")]
    assert run(document)["corpus"][0]["commands"] == ["z", "m"]


@check
def corpus_identity():
    types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
             {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
                "requires": None}]
    document = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}

    def payload(chars, result):
        objects = [cell("x%d" % (1 + i), code, 1) for i, code in enumerate(chars)]
        objects.append(cell("x4", result, 1))
        return {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    # Bytes after a NUL, object order and the model result never take part.
    document["runs"] = [payload([97, 0, 0], 0), payload([97, 0, 200], 9)]
    answer = run(document)
    assert [r["status"] for r in answer["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE"]
    assert answer["records"][1]["model_result"] == 9
    assert answer["corpus"][0]["witnesses"] == [0, 1]
    document["runs"] = [payload([97, 0, 0], 0), payload([97, 99, 0], 0)]
    answer = run(document)
    assert [r["status"] for r in answer["records"]] == ["READY", "READY"]
    # Different entries never merge.
    modules.append({"name": "m2", "params": [["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
                    "requires": None})
    document["modules"] = modules
    document["entries"] = ["m", "m2"]
    document["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest([cell("x1", 97, 1),
                                                       cell("x2", 0, 1),
                                                       cell("x3", 0, 1),
                                                       cell("x4", 0, 1)])},
                        {"entry": "m2", "ktest": ktest([cell("x1", 97, 1),
                                                       cell("x2", 0, 1),
                                                       cell("x3", 0, 1),
                                                       cell("x4", 0, 1)])}]
    answer = run(document)
    assert len(answer["corpus"]) == 2


@check
def precedence():
    types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
             {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
             {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["s0", "s1"]}]
    modules = [
        {"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"], ["n", "U8"]],
         "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "U8", 50]]},
        {"name": "f", "params": [["q", "U8"]], "result": ["o", "U8"],
         "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "U8", 0]]},
    ]
    machine = {"states": ["s0", "s1"], "initial": "s0", "state_param": "state",
               "message_param": "msg",
               "transitions": [{"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "go",
                                "cost": 1,
                                "when": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "U8", 10]]}]}
    document = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [],
                "pipes": [{"target": "entry", "filter": "f", "bind": {"q": "n"}}],
                "entries": ["entry"], "machine": machine, "runs": []}

    def payload(index, message, n, flag, drop=None):
        objects = [cell("x0", index, 4),
                   cell("x2", ord(message[0]), 1), cell("x3", 0, 1),
                   cell("x4", n, 1), cell("x5", 0, 1), cell("x6", flag, 1)]
        if drop:
            objects = [o for o in objects if o[0] != drop]
        return {"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    for run_input, expected in [
            ((1, "hi", 5, 0, None), "READY"),
            ((1, "hi", 5, 0, "x4"), "INVALID_TEST"),   # transport beats filter
            ((1, "hi", 20, 0, None), "UNREACHABLE"),
            ((1, "hi", 60, 0, None), "FILTERED"),       # filter beats reach
            ((1, "hi", 0, 1, None), "FILTERED"),
            ((1, "hi", 60, 1, None), "INVALID_TEST")]:  # flag beats predicate
        document["runs"] = [payload(*run_input)]
        assert run(document)["records"][0]["status"] == expected, run_input


@check
def scoping_and_patterns():
    types = [
        {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
        {"name": "Str3", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
        {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "U8", "size": 3},
    ]

    def document(requires):
        modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["x", "U8"], ["xs", "Arr"]],
                    "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": requires}]
        return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}

    def payload(x, xs):
        objects = [cell("x0", x, 1)]
        objects += [cell("x%d" % (2 + i), value, 1) for i, value in enumerate(xs)]
        objects.append(cell("x5", 0, 1))
        return {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

    shadow = ["and",
              ["and", ["eq", ["var", "x"], ["const", "U8", 1]],
               ["all", "x", ["var", "xs"], ["eq", ["var", "x"], ["const", "U8", 1]]]],
              ["eq", ["var", "x"], ["const", "U8", 1]]]
    doc = document(shadow)
    doc["runs"] = [payload(1, [1, 1, 1])]
    assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
    doc["runs"] = [payload(1, [1, 0, 1])]
    assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"
    # Modulo arithmetic of the integer type.
    doc = document(["eq", ["sub", ["var", "x"], ["const", "U8", 7]],
                    ["const", "U8", 0]])
    doc["runs"] = [payload(7, [0, 0, 0])]
    assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
    doc = document(["eq", ["add", ["var", "x"], ["const", "U8", 200]],
                    ["const", "U8", 191]])
    doc["runs"] = [payload(91, [0, 0, 0])]
    assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
    # The pattern grammar has no `+`; `*` is the repetition operator.
    doc = document(["all", "e", ["var", "xs"],
                    ["or", ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "U8", 0]],
                     ["lt", ["var", "e"], ["const", "U8", 5]]]])
    doc["runs"] = [payload(1, [0, 1, 4])]
    assert run(doc)["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"


@check
def framing():
    good = json.dumps({"types": [], "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                       "entries": [], "machine": None, "runs": []}).encode()
    for payload, expected in [
            (good, '{"plans":[],"records":[],"corpus":[]}'),
            (b'{"a":1} {"b":2}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'{"a":1,"a":2}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'{"a":NaN}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'{"a":1e999}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'{"a":1}trailing', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
            (b'\xff', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}')]:
        code, out = run_raw(payload)
        assert code == 0 and out.strip() == expected, (payload, out)


def main():
    failures = 0
    for function in CHECKS:
        try:
            function()
        except AssertionError as exc:
            failures += 1
            print("FAIL %s: %s" % (function.__name__, exc))
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive only
            failures += 1
            print("ERROR %s: %r" % (function.__name__, exc))
        else:
            print("PASS %s" % function.__name__)
    print("%d/%d checks passed" % (len(CHECKS) - failures, len(CHECKS)))
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
